name: Donny Donut: Stardust
storyline:
Donny & his siblings Donno and Donna were enjoying the Stardust Festival when what seemed to be a shooting star fell to the Candy Kingdom. They then went to the impact point, where they found a small Star Girl. She's named Twinkie and belongs to the Stellans, a mighty tribe of Stars which's goal is to keep balance within the universe. With these great powers, many evil faces desired to acquire it to further their evil plans... So was Burger King's aim! He captured the majority of the Stellans to use their powers to master the powers of Black Holes...

Without further ado, Donny and his friends went on their way to help Twinkie and save the universe from the menace of Burger King! They must free the Stellans Elders to awaken the power hidden within them. They will travel through Donny's Planet, and beyond to find the Elders and stop Burger King's Plan ! Will the heroes find their inner power to save the day ?
summary: Welcome to the world of Donny Donut, a world full of colors and sweets! This time, Donny will travel through many planets and galaxies to save the whole universe from the evil Burger King!
